extraction.notes: No summer 2027 facts were found. Direct opens of the website and supplied 2026 brochure returned no readable content; evidence below uses exact official-page wording returned by search indexing. Registration opening dates and current availability could not be verified. The Day Camp page conflicts internally: its summary says rising grades 1–6, its body says completed Kindergarten–5, and an indexed older description says 8am–5pm while the current body says 8am–4:30pm with Friday pickup at 3pm. Its July 12–17 date range is reproduced without correcting the Sunday start. The archive also lists Pioneers, Climb High, and Kairos Confirmation Camp, but current program details could not be retrieved; these require follow-up rather than treating them as excluded. Gathering Expedition has duplicate youth pages and a separate adult-leader page; duplicate youth listings are consolidated. Location addresses, registration platform URLs, and required fees could not be reliably extracted.

excluded.name: Grandparents Camp
excluded.reason: Grandparents and grandchildren attend together; family-only camp.

cards.name: PreKamp
cards.description: Children participate in faith formation, songs, games, crafts, and outdoor activities.

lunch.details: Bring lunch; snack is provided. Campers must be potty-independent.
lunch.quote: Bring your own lunch. Snack is provided.

cards.name: Day Camp at Lutheridge
cards.description: Activities may include swimming, crafts, archery, canoeing, nature hikes, scavenger hunts, field games, and indoor climbing.

hours.quote: Drop off at 8:00am. Pick up at 4:30pm. (closing program and pick up at 3:00pm on Friday).

lunch.quote: Breakfast and lunch are included daily.

cards.name: First Camp
cards.description: Campers participate in faith formation, swimming, crafts, and songs. Full-week and two-night sampler options are offered.

cards.name: Crazy Cool Campout
cards.description: Campers camp outdoors for one night, hike, climb, and cook a meal over a campfire.

cards.name: Bike & Hike Explorers
cards.description: Campers learn mountain-biking basics onsite with a certified instructor, then ride a guided beginner trail in Dupont State Park.

cards.name: Sky Explorers
cards.description: Campers traverse a high ropes course and participate in swimming, crafts, and camper-selected activities.

cards.name: River Explorers
cards.description: Campers take a tubing trip on the French Broad River and participate in swimming, crafts, and camper-selected activities.

cards.name: Parkway Peak Explorers
cards.description: This outdoor adventure program includes hiking and camping in the mountains.

cards.name: Parkway Peak Mountaineers
cards.description: Campers hike in the mountains and take an overnight camping trip at Mount Mitchell.

cards.name: Cave & Wave Explorers
cards.description: Campers explore Worley’s Cave, camp overnight, and go whitewater rafting.

cards.name: Cave & Wave Mountaineers
cards.description: Campers explore Worley’s Cave, camp, and go whitewater rafting.

cards.name: Night Owls Explorers
cards.description: Campers stay up later for night swims, glow-in-the-dark activities, and midnight snacks, and take an outing to Dupont State Park.

cards.name: Night Owl Mountaineers
cards.description: Campers stay up later for night swims, glow-in-the-dark activities, and midnight snacks, and take an outing to Dupont State Park.

cards.name: Rock & Raft Mountaineers
cards.description: Campers start at Lutheridge, then travel to Lutherock for hiking, rock climbing, and camping. The program also includes whitewater rafting, worship, and Bible studies.

cards.name: Soak & Soar Mountaineers
cards.description: Campers use Lutheridge’s challenge tower and zipline, then travel to Nantahala Outdoor Center for ziplining, an overnight campout, and whitewater rafting.

cards.name: Soak & Soar Explorers
cards.description: Campers use Lutheridge’s challenge tower and travel to Nantahala Outdoor Center for ziplining, camping, and rafting.

cards.name: Campfirmation
cards.description: Confirmation classes participate in faith learning and camp activities such as swimming, games, crafts, Bible study, and worship.

cards.name: Gathering Expedition Camp
cards.description: Campers live in cabins with counselors and participate in swimming, crafts, and offsite adventure and service outings. Evenings include worship, music, speakers, dances, and night swims.

cards.name: Summershine
cards.description: Teens and adults with developmental disabilities participate in crafts, singing, games, swimming, worship, and daily devotions.

special_needs.details: For developmental disabilities; counselor-to-camper ratio is 1:4. Campers must be toilet independent and able to walk distances and hills.
special_needs.quote: Summershine offers a camp experience for teens (15 years and older) and adults with developmental disabilities.

cards.name: Lutheroad Day Camp
cards.description: Lutheridge staff bring music, arts and crafts, games, nature activities, and Bible study to partner churches.
